task: Write the script for your Toastmasters Ice Breaker speech (300+ words). Introduce yourself through three moments in your life. Start with a line that makes people listen.
zh: 写你的 Toastmasters 破冰演讲稿（300 词以上）。通过人生中的三个片段介绍你自己。开头要用一句能抓住听众的话。

task: Write a team announcement (300+ words) about a new on-call roster that starts next month. Explain what changes, why, and how people can swap shifts or ask questions.
zh: 写一份团队通知（300 词以上），宣布下个月开始实行新的值班表。解释有什么变化、为什么，以及大家怎么换班或提问。

task: Write a persuasive pitch (300+ words) asking your managers to pay for a new monitoring tool. Show the cost of doing nothing, what the tool gives the team, and what you want them to decide.
zh: 写一份有说服力的提案（300 词以上），请管理层出钱购买一套新的监控工具。说明不作为的代价、工具能给团队带来什么，以及你希望他们做出什么决定。

task: Write a speech (300+ words) called 'What failing taught me'. Tell one real story of failure, then give the lesson and how you use it today.
zh: 写一篇题为“失败教会我的事”的演讲稿（300 词以上）。讲一个真实的失败故事，然后说出其中的教训，以及你现在怎么运用它。

task: Write a farewell speech (300+ words) for a colleague who is leaving after ten years. Include a funny memory, what the team learned from them, and a warm goodbye.
zh: 为一位工作十年后离职的同事写一篇送别致辞（300 词以上）。包括一段有趣的回忆、团队从他们身上学到了什么，以及温暖的道别。

task: Write a pitch (300+ words) to talk your friends into walking one of New Zealand's Great Walks with you. Answer their worries about fitness, cost and weather.
zh: 写一段劝说词（300 词以上），说服朋友们和你一起走一条新西兰的“大步道”。回应他们对体力、花费和天气的担心。

task: Write a speech (300+ words) on why every adult should learn a second language. Use your own story and give the audience one small first step.
zh: 写一篇演讲稿（300 词以上），讲为什么每个成年人都应该学一门第二语言。用你自己的故事，并给听众一个小小的第一步。

task: Write an announcement (300+ words) telling all staff that the office is moving to a new building. Cover the date, what people must pack, parking and transport, and who to ask for help.
zh: 写一份通知（300 词以上），告诉全体员工办公室要搬到新大楼。包括日期、大家需要打包什么、停车和交通，以及有问题找谁。

task: Write a speech (300+ words) called 'What moving to New Zealand taught me'. Give three lessons, each with a short story.
zh: 写一篇题为“移居新西兰教会我的事”的演讲稿（300 词以上）。讲三点收获，每一点配一个小故事。

task: Write a pitch (300+ words) to your team: we should stop deploying by hand and move to automated deployments. Describe the pain today, the plan, and the first step for next week.
zh: 给你的团队写一份提案（300 词以上）：我们应该停止手动部署，改用自动化部署。描述现在的痛点、计划，以及下周的第一步。

task: Write a wedding toast (300+ words) for a close friend. Tell how you met, one story that shows who they are, and your wishes for the couple.
zh: 为一位好朋友写一篇婚礼祝酒词（300 词以上）。讲讲你们怎么认识的、一个能体现他们为人的故事，以及你对新人的祝福。

task: Write a speech (300+ words) about the best advice anyone ever gave you. Say who gave it, when you ignored it, and when you finally followed it.
zh: 写一篇演讲稿（300 词以上），讲别人给过你的最好的建议。说说是谁给的、你什么时候没听，以及最后什么时候照做了。

task: Write a blog article (300+ words) called 'A day in the life of an IT engineer' for people outside IT. Walk through one day, hour by hour, and show what people do not see.
zh: 为 IT 行业以外的人写一篇博客文章（300 词以上），题为“IT 工程师的一天”。按时间顺序讲述一天，展现别人看不到的部分。

task: Write a pitch (300+ words) asking your company to sponsor a local children's sports team. Explain what it costs, what the company gets, and why it is the right thing to do.
zh: 写一份提案（300 词以上），请你的公司赞助一支本地的儿童运动队。解释需要多少钱、公司能得到什么，以及为什么这是正确的事。

task: Write a speech (300+ words) called 'How to save money without feeling poor'. Give three practical tips, each with an example from your own life.
zh: 写一篇题为“如何省钱又不觉得穷”的演讲稿（300 词以上）。给出三条实用建议，每条配一个你自己生活中的例子。

task: Write an all-staff announcement (300+ words): from next month everyone must use a phone app to approve each login. Explain why, the steps to set it up, and where to get help.
zh: 写一份全员通知（300 词以上）：从下个月起，每个人登录时都必须用手机 App 确认。解释原因、设置步骤，以及去哪里寻求帮助。

task: Write a speech (300+ words) about a person who changed your life. Describe them, tell the moment that mattered, and say what you would tell them today.
zh: 写一篇演讲稿（300 词以上），讲一个改变了你人生的人。描述这个人，讲出那个关键的时刻，以及你今天想对他们说什么。

task: Write a persuasive speech (300+ words) to get your audience to walk for 30 minutes every day. Use facts, a personal story, and a clear call to action.
zh: 写一篇有说服力的演讲稿（300 词以上），让听众每天步行 30 分钟。用上事实、个人故事和明确的行动号召。

task: Write a funny speech (300+ words) about the small differences between daily life in China and in New Zealand. Use three examples and be kind to both sides.
zh: 写一篇幽默的演讲稿（300 词以上），讲中国和新西兰日常生活中的小差别。用三个例子，对两边都要友善。

task: Write a kick-off speech (300+ words) for a new project team that has never worked together. Explain the goal, how you will work together, and what success looks like in three months.
zh: 为一个从未合作过的新项目团队写一篇启动会讲话（300 词以上）。解释目标、大家将如何合作，以及三个月后的成功是什么样子。

task: Write a speech (300+ words) called 'Why small talk matters'. Explain why it is hard for you, what you have learned about it in New Zealand, and how it opens doors.
zh: 写一篇题为“为什么闲聊很重要”的演讲稿（300 词以上）。解释它为什么对你来说很难、你在新西兰学到了什么，以及它怎样带来机会。

task: Write a pitch (300+ words) to investors for an app idea of your own. Describe the problem, who has it, how the app solves it, and what you need from them.
zh: 为你自己构思的一个 App 写一份给投资人的提案（300 词以上）。描述问题、谁有这个问题、App 如何解决，以及你需要他们提供什么。

task: Write a speech (300+ words) to give at your team's end-of-year party. Look back at the year, thank people by name for real things they did, and look ahead.
zh: 写一篇在团队年终聚会上的讲话（300 词以上）。回顾这一年，点名感谢大家做的具体事情，并展望未来。

task: Write a letter to yourself at age 18 (300+ words). Tell your younger self what to worry about less, what to do more, and one thing not to change.
zh: 给 18 岁的自己写一封信（300 词以上）。告诉年轻的自己哪些事不必太担心、哪些事要多做，以及有一件事不要改变。

task: Write a speech (300+ words) about the fear of speaking in public. Describe how the fear feels, where it comes from, and three things that make it smaller.
zh: 写一篇关于害怕当众讲话的演讲稿（300 词以上）。描述这种恐惧的感受、它从哪里来，以及让它变小的三个办法。

task: Write a pitch (300+ words) to your neighbours: let's turn the empty land at the end of the street into a shared vegetable garden. Cover the benefits, the work, and the first meeting.
zh: 给邻居们写一份提议（300 词以上）：把街尾的空地变成共享菜园。包括好处、需要做的工作，以及第一次碰头会。

task: Write a speech (300+ words) called 'What team sport teaches us about work'. Give three lessons and link each one to a real situation in an office.
zh: 写一篇题为“团队运动教给我们的职场道理”的演讲稿（300 词以上）。讲三点启示，每一点都联系一个办公室里的真实场景。

task: Write an announcement (300+ words) with bad news: the project your team worked on for six months has been cancelled. Be honest about why, thank people, and explain what happens next.
zh: 写一份带来坏消息的通知（300 词以上）：你们团队做了六个月的项目被取消了。如实说明原因，感谢大家，并解释接下来会怎样。

task: Write a speech (300+ words) about your favourite place in New Zealand. Help the audience see, hear and smell it, and tell them why they must go.
zh: 写一篇演讲稿（300 词以上），讲你在新西兰最喜欢的地方。让听众仿佛能看到、听到、闻到那里，并告诉他们为什么一定要去。

task: Write a talk (300+ words) for non-technical staff on why they should use a password manager. Start with a story, explain it simply, and finish with what to do today.
zh: 为非技术岗位的员工写一篇讲话（300 词以上），讲为什么应该使用密码管理器。从一个故事开始，用简单的话解释，最后说今天就该做什么。

task: Write a welcome speech (300+ words) for five new staff on their first morning. Tell them what the company cares about, what their first week looks like, and one thing nobody told you when you started.
zh: 为五位第一天上班的新员工写一篇欢迎词（300 词以上）。告诉他们公司看重什么、第一周的安排，以及一件你刚入职时没人告诉你的事。

task: Write a speech (300+ words) about missing home. Describe what you miss most, what you have found here, and how you carry two homes at once.
zh: 写一篇关于想家的演讲稿（300 词以上）。描述你最想念什么、在这里找到了什么，以及你怎样同时装着两个家。

task: Write a speech (300+ words) for accepting an 'Employee of the Year' award. Be humble, tell one story from the year, and thank the people who helped you.
zh: 写一篇领取“年度最佳员工”奖的获奖感言（300 词以上）。保持谦虚，讲一个这一年里的故事，并感谢帮助过你的人。

task: Write the case you would present to your manager for a pay rise (300+ words). Show what you have delivered, how your role has grown, and what you are asking for.
zh: 写一份你向经理申请加薪的陈述（300 词以上）。展示你完成了什么、你的职责如何扩大，以及你的具体要求。

task: Write a talk (300+ words) for a class of ten-year-olds: 'What is the cloud?' Use things children know, ask them two questions, and end with something to try at home.
zh: 为一班十岁的孩子写一篇讲话（300 词以上）：“什么是云？”用孩子们熟悉的东西来讲，向他们提两个问题，最后给一件可以回家试试的事。

task: Write a debate speech (300+ words) for or against: 'Money can buy happiness.' State your side, give three arguments, and answer one argument from the other side.
zh: 写一篇辩论稿（300 词以上），支持或反对“金钱可以买到幸福”。表明立场，给出三个论点，并回应对方的一个论点。

task: Write a teaching speech (300+ words): 'How to make a good pot of Chinese tea.' Teach the steps, share a little history, and say what tea means in your family.
zh: 写一篇教学型演讲稿（300 词以上）：“怎样泡好一壶中国茶”。教步骤，讲一点历史，并说说茶在你家里意味着什么。

task: Write a speech (300+ words) for your mother's or father's 60th birthday. Tell two stories from when you were a child and say what you have never thanked them for.
zh: 为你母亲或父亲的 60 岁生日写一篇致辞（300 词以上）。讲两个你小时候的故事，并说出你从未向他们道谢的事。

task: Write a speech (300+ words) called 'My job in ten years'. Say what will disappear, what will stay, and how you are getting ready.
zh: 写一篇题为“十年后我的工作”的演讲稿（300 词以上）。说说什么会消失、什么会留下，以及你正在怎么准备。

task: Write an evaluation speech (300+ words) giving feedback on a colleague's presentation. Say what worked well, two things to improve with examples, and end on something that encourages them.
zh: 写一篇点评讲话（300 词以上），对一位同事的演示给出反馈。说说哪里做得好、两处可以改进的地方并举例，最后用鼓励的话结尾。
